title: Ultramontane

inlines.v: ULTRAMON'TANE, adjective [Latin ultra and montanus, from mons, mountain.] Being beyond the mountain. Thus France, with regard to Italy, is an ultramontane country. Bouffin is the only ultramontane painter whom the Italians seem to envy.
